test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 04 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

A gust of wind came abruptly and our sand castle__ toppled.__
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1, i.e., "tumbled down".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given word in the sentence is "**toppled**", which means to fall over or cause to fall over due to a loss of balance.

 
 
• **Example:** The vase on the shelf toppled and shattered on the floor.
 
 
 
• The correct word "**tumbled down**" means to fall suddenly, clumsily, or headlong.
 
 
• **Example: **The books on the top shelf tumbled down after the cat jumped on it.
 
 

Therefore, the **correct answer **is- '**tumbled down**'.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• "**Ran after**" means to chase or follow someone or something, with the intent of catching them.
 
• "**Turned up**" means to appear or arrive at a place unexpectedly or by chance.
 
• "**Blew out**" means to extinguish something (such as a candle) by blowing.
